spec_title: Suggest / review pipeline — entry lifecycle (draft → reviewed → published) with anon submissions

items.matched_test: board renders below hero with kanban columns

items.text: Submitted entries land with `review_status: draft`, hidden from public listings
items.matched_test: drag from 'To Do' to 'In Progress' updates the task status via API

items.text: Submitter can see their own draft via session (anon) or login (authenticated)
Owner sees review queue at `/u/{key}/review` with pending items
items.matched_test: clone returns owner_id with anon- prefix

items.text: Approve → entry becomes `published`, appears in public listings
items.matched_test: anonymous /co board renders at least one entry card

items.text: Reject → entry removed (or archived; pick one and document)
items.matched_test: archived task is hidden by default

items.text: Owner notified on new suggestion (email + in-app via CO-329)
Submitter notified on approve/reject (if email/login provided)
Atividades log records every lifecycle transition (if CO-351 shipped)
items.matched_test: every link in every seeded template page returns 2xx/3xx

items.text: `btn-sugerir` in Sala (CO-352) wired to this endpoint
E2E test: anon submits → owner approves → entry visible in public listing
items.matched_test: clone returns owner_id with anon- prefix
